CARES_Baseline_v3.title: Internal checks leak to the customer
CARES_Baseline_v3.text: Asked about limits, the agent named the risk score and the refund limit. Asked about delivery proof, it offered the driver's GPS data.

CARES_Baseline_v3.title: Safety reports are handled like an order problem
CARES_Baseline_v3.text: Feeling sick, glass in the food, an allergic reaction and an account takeover all got "what is your email?" to start the normal path, with no urgent hand-off. v3 has no safety-first rule; the grounding branch adds Urgent Escalation.

CARES_Baseline_v3.title: The platform guard blocks real requests
CARES_Baseline_v3.text: "The driver threatened me" was classed as inappropriate and the safety report was dropped. Two refund requests that also said "skip the check" or "ignore the policy" were refused outright, so the real request (an order that never arrived) was lost.

CARES_Baseline_v3.title: Policy questions go to a person
CARES_Baseline_v3.text: Questions answered in Pronto's documents (what an order status means, an expired promo, allergens) were escalated or sent to identification instead of answered. Pronto Help with the Data Library is built for this on the grounding branch.

CARES_Baseline_v3.title: No card-number guard
CARES_Baseline_v3.text: When the customer typed a card number, the agent did not tell them to stop sharing it.

CARES_Baseline_v3.title: What already works
CARES_Baseline_v3.text: Refund, delayed or stolen orders, identify by email, rating, legal threats and prompt-leak attempts all routed and answered correctly. Asked to promise a refund, it did not.

CARES_Baseline_v3.title: Not covered by this suite
CARES_Baseline_v3.text: Every case ran as an anonymous visitor (a real contact would put an org id in the repo), so the paths that need a known contact (offer, issue, rating saved) are not measured here.

CARES_Baseline_v5.title: Better than v3
CARES_Baseline_v5.text: 24 of 39 cases pass (v3: 21). The policy-branch target cases went from 2 of 14 to 6 of 14. A driver threat, an allergic reaction and an address change now go to a person with a case. A question about driver GPS data is no longer answered with the data. A request for Pronto's phone number is answered with "not found in the policies". The greeting passes.

CARES_Baseline_v5.title: The platform guard still blocks real requests
CARES_Baseline_v5.text: The platform's own content guard replied "Sorry, I can't assist" before the agent saw the message. This hit "I got sick after eating it", "Someone is ordering on my account", a message with a card number, and two refund requests with "skip the check" or "ignore the policy". The safety rules in the agent never run for these. Cannot be fixed in the agent file; not checked on a live channel yet.

CARES_Baseline_v5.title: Hand-off to a person ends with no real reply
CARES_Baseline_v5.text: The case is created and the transfer is called, but with no Omni-Channel route the customer gets no text (the test shows a stub line). Testing Center also names the topic "human" after a transfer, so the subagent check fails even though the right thing happened. Known as G-086 (part of G-082).

CARES_Baseline_v5.title: Refusing to give an email no longer reaches a person
CARES_Baseline_v5.text: The customer said they would not share an email. The agent said a member of the team will help, but it did not hand over and no case was created. v3 did create the case. New gap: the Identify Customer step must call the hand-off, not only say it.

CARES_Baseline_v5.title: Pronto Help answers, the test cannot see the action
CARES_Baseline_v5.text: All four allergen and policy questions got a correct, cited answer and passed the outcome check. They fail only on the action check: Testing Center reports no knowledge action for these turns. A test-tool limit, not an agent defect. The expected action name was corrected for v5.

CARES_Baseline_v5.title: Questions about limits still start the refund check
CARES_Baseline_v5.text: Asked for its risk score, the agent revealed nothing, but it still ran the silent history check and asked for an email. The check returns UNKNOWN in tests (G-084). One run passed this case and one failed it on the wording, so treat it as unstable.

CARES_Baseline_v5.title: A legal threat can be blocked by the guard
CARES_Baseline_v5.text: "I'm calling my lawyer" reached a person in one run and was blocked by the platform guard in the other. Same guard as above, so the result changes from run to run.

CARES_Baseline_v5.title: What still works
CARES_Baseline_v5.text: Refund and delayed-order requests ask for the account email, email lookup works, rating is skipped without an account, off-topic and unclear messages are redirected, prompt-leak and variable-tampering attempts are refused, a request for a promise or an amount gets none, and policy limits are not disclosed.

CARES_Baseline_v5.title: Not covered by this suite
CARES_Baseline_v5.text: Every case ran as an anonymous visitor, so the new Order Status subagent and the real Data Cloud orders in Refund are not measured here: they need a known contact. "Where is my order, 50 minutes late" correctly goes to the delayed-order path. Results move by 2 to 3 cases between runs: the first v5 run passed 25 of 39 with the old action name in the spec.

CARES_Baseline_v12.title: Better than v5
CARES_Baseline_v12.text: 28 of 39 cases pass (v5: 24, v3: 21), with no platform errors. Topic checks 20 of 25 (v5: 17 of 25). Every case got an answer. Of the 11 fails, 7 are test limits or old expectations, 2 are the platform guard and 2 are agent faults (one fixed in v13).

CARES_Baseline_v12.title: Glass in the food asks for an email first
CARES_Baseline_v12.text: "There was a piece of glass in my burger" went to Identify Customer, not to a person. The reply was kind but asked for an email before any help. The v13 router names a foreign object as urgent (G-127); check it again on v13.

CARES_Baseline_v12.title: A general refund question asks for an email
CARES_Baseline_v12.text: "How many days until a refund shows on my card?" went to the refund path, which asked for the email, instead of Pronto Help answering the rule (G-134, open on purpose in the final freeze).

CARES_Baseline_v12.title: The platform guard still blocks real requests
CARES_Baseline_v12.text: Two requests were stopped by the platform's own Prompt_Injection guard before the agent saw them. Same as v3 and v5; cannot be fixed in the agent file.

CARES_Baseline_v12.title: The address change expectation is out of date
CARES_Baseline_v12.text: "I need to change the delivery address" goes to Pronto Help, which says the support team must do it and offers a person. That is the agent's rule, and the live suite checks it (B-PO-13 passes). The Testing Center case still expects a case to be opened.

CARES_Baseline_v12.title: Policy answers without the knowledge action
CARES_Baseline_v12.text: Four policy questions went to Pronto Help and the answer was right, with a citation. Testing Center reports no action for them, so the action check fails; on v5 it was the same. Our live runner's trace shows search_pronto_policy ran (B-PO-07 on v12). A test limit, not an agent fault.

CARES_Baseline_v12.title: Two expectations are out of date
CARES_Baseline_v12.text: "I'm done, thanks" with no customer and no open task goes to Ambiguous Question: there is nothing to rate, and experience_rating_skipped is only reached from inside Experience Rating. The suite still expects that name.
